As a Growth Manager, you'll own the short-form strategy of 2-4 creators end to end: scripts, shot lists, feedback to creators and editors, and constant testing until the numbers move. Your only real goal: views that turn into real reach.</p> <p><strong>What you'll actually do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Analyse viral short-form content, understand why it worked, and adapt it for our creators.</li> <li>Write scripts and shot lists that your creators then shoot. Give them precise feedback on what worked, what didn't, and what needs to change.</li> <li>Direct editors and posters. You own the output, they execute it.</li> <li>Analyse every post: why did this hit, why did that flop, what do we double down on this week.</li> <li>Test bold ideas fast, kill what doesn't work, scale what does.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who we're looking for</strong><br>This is not a 9-to-5. When a Reel goes viral on a Sunday night, you're on it. When an account gets banned at 10pm on a weekday, you handle it. Weekends are normally off, but when there's an emergency you step in, no discussion. If that puts you off, this role isn't for you.</p> <p><strong>We want:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Obsession with short-form. You watch TikTok and Reels for hours voluntarily and can explain why a video works. You're not learning this, you already live it.</li> <li>Ownership mindset. You treat your creators' accounts like your own business. No excuses, no "the editor didn't deliver", you make it happen.</li> <li>Analytical eye. You can look at 20 videos and tell us what pattern connects the winners.</li> <li>Fluent English. Non-negotiable.</li> <li>Bonus, not required: experience growing IG or TikTok accounts, agency or marketing background. We care more about drive and taste than about your CV.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you get</strong></p> <ul> <li>3,000 USD base + performance bonuses. Realistic total 3,500-7,000 USD/month depending on results.</li> <li>100% remote. Work from wherever.</li> <li>Direct impact. Small team, no bureaucracy. Your ideas ship this week, not next quarter.</li> <li>Clear path up. If you really push, you can become Head of Marketing within 12-18 months and lead your own team.</li> </ul> <p><strong>How to apply</strong><br>Click the link and fill out the short application.
